stats.Effect: Captain of the powerful convict mercenary band called the Red Eye. He was drafted with other convicts during Gracia's invasion, but was abandoned by the main army during a retreat. Following the war, he and his men did not return to their country, preferring to stay in the Dion Territory occupied during the war, sacking and ambushing. He believes the Gracian Army and its commanders were cowards for leaving his men behind.
